evals.prompt: Our mid-sized fintech platform is experiencing $2.5M in annual fraud losses and high manual review costs ($500k/year for 15 analysts). We want an AI-powered real-time transaction risk scoring system. Create an enterprise AI business strategy, risk-adjusted financial model, feasibility assessment, risk matrix, stage-gate funding plan, and project roadmap.
evals.expected_output: Executive Decision Card with r-ROI and EMV, 4-pillar feasibility matrix (Tech/Data/Ops/Reg), 12-month Capex/Opex TCO model, 4 stage-gate tranches with kill-switch criteria, risk mitigation matrix, 4-phase project roadmap across 5 workstreams, and KPI dashboard.

evals.prompt: A regional hospital network wants to build a RAG-based AI copilot to automate medical prior authorization document processing. Currently, staff process 50,000 requests/year manually with a 3-day turnaround time. Develop a complete AI investment proposal, feasibility analysis, risk-adjusted financial model, and implementation roadmap.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive 6-step business strategy featuring HIPAA/EU AI Act regulatory scoring, risk-adjusted financial metrics (r-ROI, EMV), Stage-Gate funding breakdown, clinical risk mitigations, phased execution roadmap, and STP/latency KPI targets.

evals.prompt: An e-commerce retailer receives 200,000 customer support tickets per month. They want to deploy autonomous AI agents to handle order tracking, returns, and simple inquiries. Formulate a 6-step AI business strategy and funding roadmap with detailed financial modeling.
evals.expected_output: 6-step AI strategy document with Executive Decision Card, Feasibility Scoring (Tech, Data, Ops, Compliance), 12-Month Financial Model (r-ROI, EMV, TCO), Stage-Gate Capital Release Schedule, Risk Profile, Phased Roadmap Matrix, and CSAT/STP KPI Governance.
